title: 第十三章 碾压执事第十四章 敬畏
content_zh:
山间空气彻底凝住，李奎盯着眼前布衣少年，脸色彻底沉到谷底。
他活了数十年，坐镇青岚宗外门执事多年，管着整片南疆山林地界，何时被一个无名散修如此顶撞过？
退让、台阶、息事宁人。
他已经给足了对方面子。
可对方根本不接。
反而直言，青岚宗拦不住他，也没资格驱离。
这话落在耳里，已经不是简单的不知进退，是当面踏碎宗门脸面。
后方赵凯五人早已看呆了，屏住呼吸，连痛都忘了。
他们从未见过有人敢在李执事面前这么说话。
别说区区筑基初期，就算是内门核心弟子，也得给外门执事三分敬畏。
眼前这少年，根本无惧宗门，无惧境界差距。
“好，很好。”
李奎缓缓吐气，声音冷得发寒。
眼底最后一丝收敛彻底褪去，只剩下彻骨的杀意。
“本想留你一条生路，只逐不杀。”
“既然你执意找死，那我便成全你。”
话音落下的瞬间，他身上气息陡然暴涨。
筑基中期的全部修为毫无保留彻底炸开。
周身气流疯狂搅动，林间狂风骤起，落叶碎石全部离地翻飞。
比起刚才试探性的一掌，此刻的压迫感足足强了一倍不止。

这是青岚宗外门执事的真正战力，常年坐镇山林、镇压妖兽、杀伐果断，绝非养尊处优的普通修士可比。
“以为凭一个完美筑基的底子，就能越级嚣张？”
李奎双目冰冷，脚掌猛地踏地。
整个人如同离弦之箭直扑而出，身形快得拉出一道残影。
这一次，他不再留手。
双手灵气凝聚，掌风厚重沉猛，青峦掌法全力催开。
掌势层层叠加，前一掌刚至，后一掌已蓄，连绵不绝，层层镇压，专门克制同阶修士的防御、卸力。
是他镇压无数闹事散修、叛逆妖兽的绝杀连招。
劲风扑面，压迫感窒息。
换做任何一个普通完美筑基的修士，面对筑基中期全力搏杀，只会被逼得步步后退、艰难格挡。
可烬孤宸站在原地，眼神不变，心态稳得可怕。
别人的完美筑基，只是底子扎实。
他的完美筑基，是从凡尘血肉、生死绝境、万灵提纯、千锤百炼里磨出来的。
道台无瑕，灵气纯粹，经脉承载力远超常人，同阶无敌，越阶可战。
就在掌风即将贴身的一瞬。
content_en:
The air in the mountain was completely frozen. Li Kui stared at the commoner boy in front of him, his face completely sinking to the bottom of his face.
He had lived for decades, served as the deacon of the outer sect of the Qinglan Sect for many years, and was in charge of the entire mountain and forest boundary of southern Xinjiang. When had he ever been so contradicted by an unknown casual cultivator?
Make concessions, take steps, and settle things down.
He has already given the other party enough face.
But the other party didn't answer at all.
Instead, he bluntly said that the Qinglan Sect could not stop him and had no right to drive him away.
When these words fell upon his ears, it was no longer simply a matter of not knowing how to advance or retreat, but a crushing of the sect's face in front of them.
The five people behind Zhao Kai had already been stunned, holding their breaths and forgetting even the pain.
They had never seen anyone dare to speak like this in front of Deacon Li.
Let alone the initial stage of foundation building, even the core disciples of the inner sect must be in awe of the deacons of the outer sect.
The young man in front of him has no fear of the sect or the gap in realm.
"Okay, very good."
Li Kui exhaled slowly, his voice so cold that he felt cold.
The last trace of restraint in his eyes completely faded away, leaving only the bone-chilling murderous intent.
"I wanted to leave you a way to live, I just chased you away but didn't kill you."
"Since you insist on seeking death, then I will help you."
The moment he finished speaking, his aura suddenly surged.
All the cultivation levels in the middle stage of foundation building were completely exploded without any reservation.
The airflow around him stirred wildly, the wind suddenly rose in the forest, and all the fallen leaves and gravel flew off the ground.
Compared with the tentative palm just now, the pressure at this moment was more than twice as strong.
This is the true combat power of the deacons of the outer sect of Qinglan Sect. They sit in the mountains and forests all year round, suppress monsters and beasts, and kill decisively. They are by no means comparable to ordinary monks who are pampered and privileged.
"You think you can become arrogant with a perfect foundation?"
Li Kui's eyes were cold and his feet slammed on the ground.
The whole person shot straight out like an arrow from the string, and his body was so fast that an afterimage was drawn out.
This time, he didn't hold back.
The spiritual energy in both hands is condensed, the palm wind is thick and fierce, and Qingluan's palm technique is used to push it away with all its strength.
The palm power is superimposed layer by layer. The previous palm has just arrived, and the latter palm has been stored. They are continuous and suppressed layer by layer, specifically restraining the defense and offloading force of monks of the same level.
This is his ultimate combo to suppress countless troublemaking loose cultivators and rebellious monsters.
The strong wind blew against my face, and the pressure was suffocating.
If it were any ordinary monk with perfect foundation building, facing an all-out fight in the middle stage of foundation building, he would only be forced to retreat step by step and block with difficulty.
Ke Jin Guchen stood there, his eyes unchanged, his mentality terrifyingly stable.
Others’ perfect foundation is just a solid foundation.
His perfect foundation was honed from mortal flesh and blood, the desperate situation of life and death, the purification of all spirits, and countless tempers.
The Taoist platform is flawless, the spiritual energy is pure, the carrying capacity of the meridians is far beyond that of ordinary people, he is invincible at the same level, and can fight at higher levels.
At the moment when the palm wind is about to close to the body.
